asked_questions: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?

user_answers.question: Which service touchpoint or environment should this redesign cover, and what should stay out of scope?
user_answers.answer: Scope: Quality Intent Framework operational specification, canonical schemas, discovery/evaluation/governance workflows, acceptance framework, and AI-verifiable artifacts. Out of scope: building a production web app, domain-specific software-testing-only theory, and using volume metrics as quality definitions.

user_answers.question: How should improvement success be judged: which metric or end state matters most?
user_answers.answer: Success: humans and AI agents can discover Quality Intents from documents, history, operations, or expertise; collect evidence; calculate confidence; produce verdicts; govern lifecycle changes; and validate outputs against machine-readable acceptance criteria.
